newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moevenpick says sales, profit rose in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Moevenpick says sales, profit rose in Q1.

text.p: Swiss restaurant and hotel group Moevenpick Holding AG said sales and profit rose in the first three months of 1997, with revenues growing by over five percent in the period.
"We can report gains in revenues as well as profit, in fact good gains," said Paul Schwizer, general director for finance and controlling.
He said all divisions showed some improvement in earnings.

Speaking at a news briefing on Moevenpick's 1996 results, Schwizer said he was confident that Moevenpick would reach an interim goal of seven percent return on equity (ROE) this year, compared with 5.8 percent at the end of 1996.
Schwizer, asked to detail growth in the first three months, told Reuters that revenues rose by over five percent in the period. He did not elaborate on profit gains.
He also said results growth for all of 1997 would depend in part on currencies, adding that a weaker Swiss franc would favour earnings growth.
